utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it’s happening today — I’m headed over soon to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — what time should I head over?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you check the drop-off location and the exact time window first? If those are set, I can line up the rest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely—I’ll check the drop-off location and the exact time window first, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll start organizing the repair drive and keep everyone in the loop. Let’s make a clear list of the needed fixes and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Count me in — I usually join late, but I can help with whatever’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — that’s really helpful. I’ll keep a running list of open tasks and send you the leftovers once the sign-up comes in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting organized, but I’m still catching up on the details. What’s the latest you’ve heard, Gus?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve heard they’re sorting donations this weekend and matching folks with the right repairs after that. If you need a tool or two, I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be really helpful, Gus—thank you. I’m still piecing it together, so I’ll check back once I know what I need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Leo. The next thing I need is someone to help sort the donated parts and keep track of who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do that. Send me the list, and I’ll sort the parts and track the donations.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to help spread the word about the repair drive, and I’ll remind a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great, Vik — I can help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Sam — I’ll keep reminding a few neighbors, and we can make sure everyone hears about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’m telling everyone about the repair drive already. If you want, I can swing by your place and help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be kind of you, Quinn. Let’s keep it simple — stop by after lunch and I’ll have a short list ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll stop by after lunch and grab the list. Then I’ll start spreading the word right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard anything concrete yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear when the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I’d really appreciate that. I always seem to forget the details, so I’m glad you’re keeping an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll ask around and tell you as soon as I hear the date.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around the school schedule — what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet — I’m trying to confirm the time and make sure it doesn’t clash with school pickup. If I get the details, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds good — just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s still moving along, just a bit quietly. I’d check in with the folks organizing it for the newest update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll check with them when I can. Thanks for the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Cleo, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’m still in, and I’ve been keeping an eye on the supplies we’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you handle the supplies list, or should I?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I need to know the exact drop-off time and where the repairs are being taken. If we can sort the logistics, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure of the exact drop-off yet, but I’ll ask around and get back to you. I know it’s somewhere nearby, just not the full details yet.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Nell. Just let me know when you have the drop-off time and exact place, and I can plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, Gus, just to confirm — is the repair drive still happening today?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still happening today — I’m heading over in a bit with my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just making sure — what time are you headed over?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what time are we meeting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s meet at 9:00 by the community shed, and please bring work gloves, a flashlight, and any spare tools you have.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I’ll be there at 9:00 by the community shed with my gloves, flashlight, and a couple spare tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — the repair drive is still on, and I heard they’re collecting donations and a few volunteers this weekend. If you want, I can pass along the details I heard.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, please pass them along — I’ll tell a couple neighbors and see who can help this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together a little repair drive, and I’d love for you to come by if you’re free. I’ll send the details over as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds wonderful, Quinn—thank you for thinking of me. Send the details when you can, and I’ll do my best to come by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send them your way as soon as I’ve got everything sorted, and I’m really glad you might make it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Dane — what do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you help me make a quick list of what still needs fixing? I’m a bit late, so that’d get me caught up fast.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help where I can, but I need to keep things quiet today. Let me know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can still help a bit, just nothing loud or public today. Tell me the next small job and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive — what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you bring your toolbox and help check the loose porch railing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring my toolbox and take a look at the porch railing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check what supplies we’ve got and see what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — just let me know what’s missing and I’ll help round it up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m on it — I’ll take inventory and tell you what’s missing as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a good turn-out for the repair drive — I’m happy to help bring folks together. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and maybe bring a few tools if you can? I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and bring a few tools along too. Just let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive if you need an extra pair of hands. What’s the next thing on the list?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s kind of you, Rey — I keep misplacing the list, but I think the next thing is sorting the donated tools. If you’re free, we could probably tackle that together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What time is it again?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the time first—what time do you have written down for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I don’t have it written down either—did you say it was this afternoon?
